title: Milestone 2026.04.57 Operational Retrospective — Full Analysis (Augmented)
augmentation_note: Conductor-generated Exp 753 artifact (schema carnot.retro.v1) reports cycle-only data (235 min, 14 experiments, slowest-5 = all new productive experiments). This file is the authoritative full-milestone retro, augmented with provided timing data: 3674 min, 599 experiments. The conductor cycle correctly achieved a complete slowest-5 composition change for the first time in project history — ALL legacy experiments absent from the 14-experiment managed cycle. However, full-milestone timing shows the legacy experiments still ran outside the conductor's managed cycle, consuming 316 min of the total 3674 min. Conductor cycle data preserved in conductor_cycle_* fields below.
conductor_vs_actual_gap_explanation: Conductor cycle covered 14 targeted new experiments (235 min). Full milestone included 599 cumulative experiments from all queue sources (3674 min). The 316-min legacy re-execution overhead (Exps 425, 410, 383, 380-382, 527) is the dominant recoverable component. IMPORTANT: The conductor cycle's slowest-5 achieved a complete composition change — no legacy experiments appeared in the managed 14-experiment cycle. This is a genuine win for the focused roadmap strategy. However, without manifest code enforcement, legacy experiments continued to run from unguarded queue sources outside the conductor's managed cycle.

bottlenecks_identified: CRITICAL: MANIFEST FIX PATCH NOT APPLIED TO DISPATCH CODE — FOURTH CONSECUTIVE CYCLE. results/manifest_fix_patch.txt written in Exp 731 (.56), labeled MANDATORY HUMAN ACTION. Exp 740 (.57 preflight) confirmed manifest_enforcement_applied=false. Legacy experiments were absent from the conductor cycle ONLY because the .57 roadmap was a focused 14-experiment set. Without code enforcement, any legacy experiment re-entering any queue from any source will re-execute. The .57 result (complete conductor-cycle composition change) is fragile: it depends on roadmap focus, not infrastructure. Full-milestone legacy overhead: 316 min (8.6% of 3674 min total).

LEGACY QUEUE RUNS OUTSIDE CONDUCTOR MANAGEMENT — 585 EXPERIMENTS UNMANAGED. The conductor cycle managed 14 experiments (235 min). The remaining 585 experiments (3,439 min) ran from unguarded queue sources. This structural gap means governance rules enforced in the conductor's planning phase can be bypassed by any legacy queue item. Manifest code enforcement at the dispatch site is the only fix — it covers all queue sources, not just the conductor's managed cycle.

FULL-MILESTONE LEGACY RE-EXECUTION: 316 MINUTES WASTED. Combined legacy overhead (76+64+62+62+52=316 min) consumed in .57 full milestone despite: four formal retirement confirmations, one manifest patch write, and RETRO-033 definitive closure. Conductor cycle correctly excluded all legacy experiments. Full queue did not. This 316 min is a recoverable floor: it disappears the moment the manifest patch is applied to the dispatch site.

EXP 527 FULL-MILESTONE FOURTH APPEARANCE — GOVERNANCE VIOLATED. Governance mandated mandatory retirement after three consecutive appearances (triggered in .56). RETRO-033 definitively closed by Exp 742. Exp 527 class ran from the legacy queue in .57 despite both conditions for retirement being met. This is a governance protocol violation — not merely delayed action.

PSV RELAPSE DETECTED IN EXP 749. fp_rate_slope_new30=+0.00110 (positive = deteriorating in recent 30 iterations). Prior recovery (domain-diverse training, Exp 737) held in .56 but reversed in .57. All-60 slope still negative from accumulated recovery, but trend reversed. Architecture review mandatory in .58 Phase 0. This is a new open RETRO (RETRO-PSV-RELAPSE) and the highest-priority research finding from the .57 cycle.

ITERATIVE CODE REPAIR BLOCKED BY MISSING ENV VAR. Exp 744 (arXiv 2604.10508, expected 4.9-17.1pp HumanEval improvement) blocked because CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=1 was not set. This is a one-line environment variable that could have been set in the conductor prompt. The 4.9-17.1pp improvement remains unconfirmed in the Carnot pipeline. Set CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=1 before .58 dispatch.

HLS ENERGY SIGN BUG BLOCKS FPGA SYNTHESIS. Exp 750 HLS C++ kernel compiles but CPU validation failed (energy_delta_pct=200.0: got +3.0 vs expected -3.0). Sign convention error in E += J[i][j]*s[i]*s[j] (should be E -=). KV260 board arrived 2026-04-20 — hardware synthesis unblocked on tool availability, but a synthesis with wrong energy sign would produce an incorrect Ising sampler. Fix sign before running synthesis.

VITIS HLS NOT ON PATH — SYNTHESIS STILL BLOCKED. RETRO-072 open for 4 consecutive milestones. KV260 board now on-hand (arrived 2026-04-20). AMD Vitis 2024.2 installation remains the blocking action. Add tool_available pre-check gate to prevent synthesis experiments from queueing when vitis_hls is absent.

PER-EXPERIMENT AVERAGE REGRESSED FROM PROJECT BEST. .56 achieved 6.0 min/exp (project best). .57 full-milestone: 6.13 min/exp — slight regression. Conductor cycle avg: 235/13=18.1 min/exp on wall-clock, dominated by Exp 742's 19.68 min live GPU inference (expected). The 6.13 overall is near-best and consistent with 12 new experiments at ~6 min plus the legacy overhead raising the average.

TIER 2 CROSS-SESSION MEMORY TEMPLATE ACCUMULATION UNCLEAR. Exp 748 total_templates_at_s10=0 despite templates_replayed_per_session=[0,2,2,...,2]. Templates are being replayed but not accumulated. Either template persistence to disk is not working, or the template count metric measures something different from what is expected. Investigate before building further Tier 2 capabilities on this substrate.

GPU CLOSE CLEAN — STREAK NOW 2. Both GPUs at 4MB/0%/54C (GPU 0) and 45C (GPU 1). 9C thermal differential confirms GPU 1 idle throughout all 599 experiments. Streak = 2 (.56 and .57). GPU 0 at 54C is slightly warmer than .56 close (47C), consistent with modest cycle compute. No zombie detected.

CONDUCTOR-VS-ACTUAL GAP STRUCTURAL: 3439 MINUTES. This gap is inherent to the dual-queue architecture (conductor managed cycle + unguarded legacy queue). It will close only when manifest code enforcement brings the legacy queue under conductor governance. Focused roadmaps reduce the gap within the conductor cycle but do not address legacy queue activity.
improvements_suggested: PRIORITY 0 — APPLY MANIFEST FIX PATCH BEFORE ANY .58 DEQUEUE (FINAL WARNING, FOURTH CYCLE). Apply results/manifest_fix_patch.txt to scripts/research_conductor.py at the experiment dispatch site NOW. This is the fourth consecutive cycle this is listed as PRIORITY 0. The .57 result (conductor cycle composition change) proves the roadmap strategy works but does not substitute for code enforcement. Without the patch, any legacy experiment re-entering any queue from any source will re-execute. Estimated recovery: 316 min/milestone (8.6% of .57 total). This single change recovers more wall time than 4.5 consecutive organic improvements at the current deceleration rate.

PRIORITY 1 — DIAGNOSE AND RESOLVE PSV RELAPSE (RETRO-PSV-RELAPSE). Exp 749 fp_rate_slope_new30=+0.00110 reverses the domain-diverse recovery from Exp 737. PRIORITY 7 — INVESTIGATE CROSS-SESSION MEMORY TEMPLATE PERSISTENCE. Exp 748 total_templates_at_s10=0. Test whether templates are written to disk between sessions or only held in memory. Fix persistence path before building further Tier 2 self-learning capabilities.
PRIORITY 8 — MAINTAIN GPU CLOSE DISCIPLINE. Streak at 2. Assert VRAM < 100MB and util = 0% for both GPUs in .58 Phase 0 preflight. Kill any zombie process before dispatching experiments.

PRIORITY 9 — ENCODE RETIREMENT GOVERNANCE IN CONDUCTOR CODE. Text-based governance has 0% enforcement rate in the legacy queue (proven across 21 milestones for Exp 425). Add code to scripts/research_conductor.py: if experiment.id in slowest5 for N >= 3 consecutive full-milestone cycles, generate retirement_review as Experiment 0 of next roadmap. Converts an infinite deferral problem into a maximum 3-cycle window.

PRIORITY 10 — STRUCTURED TIMING LOG AT CONDUCTOR DISPATCH SITE. The conductor-vs-actual gap (3,439 min in .57) requires external timing data to construct full-milestone retros. Logging start_iso, end_iso, duration_s at the dispatch site would make retro construction exact and automated.
